newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai finmin Amnuay to resign on June 19-adviser.
newsitem.headline: Thai finmin Amnuay to resign on June 19-adviser.

text.p: Thailand's Finance Minister Amnuay Viravan will submit his resignation letter to the prime minister on Thursday (June 19), his adviser said on Wednesday.
"We are sent here to confirm that he wll resign and submit his resignation letter tomorrow," the adviser Pongsathorn Siriyothin told reporters

The adviser's statement ended speculation and rumours that had been rife all day that the embattled Amnuay would be leaving his job. The rumours had driven down the battered Thai bourse to a new 98-month-low close and caused the Thai baht to slip.
"This is to confirm rumours going around all day that the minister could hand in his resignation," he said.
Earlier, Amnuay declined to state clearly his intentions.

The unelected Amnuay, who has been managing Thailand's ailing economy, has been a target of some political rivals within Chavalit's six-party coalition for some time, political sources said. His rivals have wanted him replaced because they were unhappy with his performance and style, they added.

Thailand has been wracked by a sharp economic downturn, high interest rates that have choked businesses, a plunging stock market, slowing consumer and investor spending and a baht that has been under speculative attack last month.
